brief: Improve the Quirk Control shell without flattening information density or hiding authority state.
desiredOutcome: Faster orientation, safer governance actions, and reusable shell patterns.
prohibitedChanges: Do not rename project-scaffold to Quirk OS.
Do not grant release or canon authority to an agent.
Do not invent metrics or operator states.

criteria.title: Primary action remains legible
criteria.requirement: The current primary action is visible and distinguishable at 320px, 768px, and 1440px without horizontal scrolling.

criteria.title: Authority is explicit
criteria.requirement: Proposed, approved, active, and rejected states cannot be confused through color alone.

criteria.title: Distinctive without decorative noise
criteria.requirement: The shell contains at least two reusable decisions tied to Quirk governance rather than generic dashboard styling.
